items.title: Elfelejtett sziget
items.overview: Jo és Raissa a Nakali nevű, elfeledett sziget különös világában rekednek. Rájönnek, hogy az egyetlen út hazafelé talán egy egész életnyi emlék és érzelem feláldozását követeli.  (Csillag Lajos)

items.title: The Weight
items.overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

items.title: Billie
items.overview: Nina and Angie are best friends and struggle through life together. When Angie's teenage daughter Rahel needs €300 for a school trip, they decide to go to the bank where Nina's husband Marc works to ask him for a small loan. But when Marc harshly rejects their request, Angie loses her temper. Things get out of control—and suddenly the friends are stuck in the bank and mistaken for gangsters.

items.title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
items.overview: On the morning of his hundredth birthday, Fanny finds her grandfather dead in his bed. As she and her family are forced to deal with the death, a bitter dispute over the inheritance erupts, in which old power relations are reversed.

items.title: National Theatre Live: The Misanthrope
items.overview: Alice, a brilliant novelist, despises the hollow contemporary mantras of kindness and respect. But the bolder she becomes in speaking out, the more colleagues avoid her, and the more her personal relationships begin to fracture. As she challenges fashionable ideas and lends her voice to causes others are afraid to touch, she faces intense criticism and backlash. Alice will soon learn the price she must pay as an artist and as a woman for daring to speak her mind. Award-winner Sandra Oh is the Misanthrope in Martin Crimp's cutting new version of Molière's dark comedy, directed by National Theatre Director Indhu Rubasingham.

items.title: Another Day
items.overview: Garance is a young actress, but not a star. She manages everything as best she can, valiant, cheerful, a soldier, and she finds in alcohol an unconditional fuel, a source of comfort. Garance changes her life and begins an eight-year journey of moves, work, encounters, parties and anxieties, joys and hardships… An intimate, friendly, and sexual revolution. But she consumes, more and more. Until the very possibility of death…

items.title: Possible Love
items.overview: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

items.title: Az utolsó vonat Fortune-ba
items.overview: Egy iskolaigazgató és egy törvényen kívüli különös szövetségre lépnek, amikor a főhős lekési a Fortune-ba tartó utolsó vonatot, és kénytelen vele tartani a vadnyugati úton. Útjuk során lövöldözések, szökések és furcsa, váratlan találkozások sorozata teszi próbára a kapcsolatukat, miközben lassan sajátos barátság alakul ki közöttük.

items.title: He Calls Me Daughter
items.overview: A documentary exploring the lasting impact of the father wound on women and the hope, healing, and restored identity found through the love of God as the perfect Father.

items.title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
items.overview: After Islamist terrorists hijack a college's pro-Palestine encampment with the goal of enforcing Sharia law on students and executing dissidents whom they deem "infidels", a group of students, a security guard, and a Delta Force veteran team up to fight back.

items.title: Elfelejtett sziget
items.overview: Jo és Raissa a Nakali nevű, elfeledett sziget különös világában rekednek. Rájönnek, hogy az egyetlen út hazafelé talán egy egész életnyi emlék és érzelem feláldozását követeli.  (Csillag Lajos)

items.title: Godmother
items.overview: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

items.title: Pathetic Fallacy
items.overview: A young widower arrives in a new-age mountain town in search of cosmic answers and a chance to heal. Instead, he finds an outlandish murderer and a forest of demonic spirits who offer a horrific bargain: the power to cheat death at a nightmarish cost.

items.title: Possible Love
items.overview: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

items.title: The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest
items.overview: A rational urban man defies his ancestral village's forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, forcing him to confront powers beyond logic as he becomes the unlikely saviour protecting his people from annihilation.

items.title: Unabomber
items.overview: In this drama inspired by true events, Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy to the infamous Unabomber unfolds as the FBI hunts him down.
